notes: Format-faithful synthetic USPTO Open Data Portal quarterly release for the PVGPATDIS product: product metadata (live envelope shape, captured 2026-08 via verify-live) naming three per-table zips among decoy entries, plus the tables themselves. Exercises: selection by fileName (dictionary/clustering decoys lead the bag), a mapped assignee by exact name (Microsoft Corporation -> MSFT), an unmapped assignee (Example Innovations Inc.), an unassigned patent (no assignee rows, name stays null, kind null, cpcClass null), a multi-assignee design patent whose organization sits at sequence 1 behind a sequence-0 individual (first-listed ORG wins by sequence, assigneeCount keeps the total of 2, prefix-mapped Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation -> NOC), a reissue patent mapped after suffix-stripping (International Business Machines Corporation -> IBM) whose sequence-0 CPC row has an empty cpc_class (passed over for sequence 1, lowercased g06 uppercased to G06), CPC sequence order beating file order (11900001), a quoted title carrying escaped quotes plus an embedded tab and newline (11900002), a withdrawn patent that parses but is never emitted (11900004), an unparseable grant date counted as the one parse failure (11900006), and one assignee row with no patent_id counted as unusable.
